command:
Implement task U8 from tasks.toml: Pin vendored htmx checksum

Run vendor_assets.sh once, record HTMX_SHA256, and add a CI job that re-verifies the checksum. Left unpinned at scaffold time because the authoring sandbox had no network egress.

Exit criteria (every one must pass before you stop):
  - HTMX_SHA256 populated
  - CI fails on checksum mismatch (test)

Constraints:
  - Touch only these paths: scripts/vendor_assets.sh, .gitlab-ci.yml
  - Work on branch task/U8-pin-vendored-htmx-checksum; create it from the current HEAD if absent.
  - Verify with: ./scripts/test
  - Then run: python3 scripts/backlog.py  (must exit 0)
  - When the exit criteria pass, set the status of this task to review in tasks.toml. Never set it to done -- only CI and a human reviewer do that.
  - Follow CLAUDE.md. Minimal diffs, no speculative refactors, no changes outside the paths above.
